title: Shipyard Supply: Fuel Tank at Deep Range Outpost: 14 fuel tanks bought at Unknown Edge Waystation, carried 3 jumps and delivered for 9,515 cr (Outer Rim haulers)
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-23 04:14 UTC (orders.log ENT-071, P6: the newborns' class work where they were born, work that repeats there; rule F23: carrying is the hauler's). Deep Range Outpost's board (data/missions, read 03:53 UTC) posts 68 copies of the station's procurement Shipyard Supply: Fuel Tank, 14 fuel tanks for 9,515 cr and 20 Piloting XP each, a new mission_id every copy and no template: the accept entry names the title (route_run, commit 9a65d1dd). Unknown Edge Waystation's book (03:51 UTC) asks fuel tanks at 592 x 1,600 (Ramen's Rest 592 x 1,146, Starfall 592 x 256): 14 tanks cost about 8,370 cr with the 1 percent, the hold takes 42 of 65 (size 3); about +1,150 cr a run before fuel. Jumps (game/map/galaxy.tsv): Altais to Unknown Edge 1, Unknown Edge to Deep Range 3. A pilot that holds 14 tanks skips the buy (skip_if_hold); a run the board no longer offers leaves the tanks aboard for the next. Test (rules F12, F37): one ship first, then three results; requires.empire outerrim keeps it to the Rim newborns; min_credits 11,500 keeps the 3,000 floor over the goods. 2026-11-23 04:33 UTC (Apollo): the buy stop first stores the whole hold and takes back up to 14 fuel tank from storage there: the first runs (04:16 and 04:18 UTC) got 13 of 14 tanks and 11 of 12 cores, the newborns' holds carrying 20 fuel cells and mission leftovers (73 of 75 used), and the delivery was refused for goods missing.
